properties.notes: Commercial garage premises that comprises of a showroom and forecourt for car sales, workshops and offices. Demolition would be required, along with any necessary remediation. Relocation of the existing business to a new location would also be required. There are constraints to access, which would have to be overcome. Highlighted as being considered for residential development in the past, and it could represent an opportunity for a small-scale scheme. An existing business remains operating from the site and there has been no recent indication of relocation and/or change in circumstances. There still may be potential in the long-term but no residential development is forecast within the plan period at present.
properties.ownership-status: not owned by a public authority
